blocks.title: Exception handling
blocks.text: Exception handling program chalte waqt hone wali ghaltiyan sambhalti hai, ta ke program crash hone ki bajaye chalta rahe ya saleeqe se band ho.

blocks.prompt: Program crash hone dene ki bajaye exceptions kyun sambhalein?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke program mufeed paigham dikha sake, sambhal sake ya saaf band ho, aur users ke liye zyada mazboot ho.

items: Exception handling: chalte waqt ki ghaltiyan saleeqe se sambhalna.
